extraction.name: LAMBADA
extraction.description: A dataset to evaluate the capabilities of computational models for text understanding by means of a word prediction task.
extraction.creator: Denis Papemo, Germán Kruszewski, Angeliki Lazaridou, Quan Ngoc Pham, Raffaella Bemardi, Sandro Pezzelle, Marco Baroni, Gemma Boleda, Raquel Fernández
extraction.rai:dataCollection: LAMBADA consists of passages composed of a context (on average 4.6 sentences) and a target sentence. The task is to guess the last word of the target sentence (the target word). The LAMBADA data come from the Book Corpus. A random sample of the remaining passages were then evaluated by human subjects through the CrowdFlower crowdsourcing service.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The LAMBADA data come from the Book Corpus (Zhu et al., 2015).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: To reduce time and cost of dataset collection, we filtered out passages that are relatively easy for standard language models. We used a combination of four language models to exclude passages whose target word had probability ≥0.00175 according to any of the language models.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: A random sample of the remaining passages were then evaluated by human subjects through the CrowdFlower crowdsourcing service in three steps. For a given passage, one human subject guessed the target word based on the whole passage; if the guess was right, a second subject guessed the target word based on the whole passage; if that guess was also right, more subjects tried to guess the target word based on the target sentence only, until the word was guessed or the number of unsuccessful guesses reached 10.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The LAMBADA items contain (quoted) direct speech significantly more often than the input items overall (71% of LAMBADA items vs. 61% of items in the input sample).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The criteria for passage inclusion were very strict: We required two consecutive subjects to exactly match the missing word, and we made sure that no subject (out of ten) was able to provide it based on local context only, even when given 3 guesses.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used to test several existing language modeling architectures, including systems with capacity to hold longer-term contextual memories. The development data can be used to fine-tune models to the specifics of the LAMBADA passages.
